m.n: Mary, Mother of God & The Rosary

co.n: Mary, Mother of God & The Rosary Cohort

c.p: What does the Catholic dogma of the "Theotokos" (Mother of God) proclaim about the Virgin Mary?
c.a: mary is truly the mother of god because jesus is fully god and fully man in one divine person | mother of god because jesus is god incarnate | theotokos god bearer
c.h: Affirmed at the Council of Ephesus (431 AD) in response to Nestorius.
c.e: Because Jesus Christ is true God and true man undivided in one divine Person, Mary—who gave birth to Jesus—is legitimately honored as the Mother of God / Theotokos (CCC 495, 509).
r: that catholics worship mary equal god almighty
Catholics venerate (hyperdulia) Mary with honor as the mother of the Redeemer, but worship and adoration (latria) belong strictly to God alone.

c.p: What is the core spiritual purpose of praying the Holy Rosary?
c.a: to meditate on the life, passion, death, and glory of jesus christ through the eyes of mary | meditating on the mysteries of christ with mary | contemplating the gospel mysteries
c.h: The Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, and Glorious mysteries guide the Christian through the Gospels.
c.e: The Rosary is a biblical prayer where repeated vocal prayers form a meditative background for contemplating the principal mysteries of Christ's life and salvation (CCC 971, 2708).
r: saying words fast possible count beads
The Rosary is an interior contemplative prayer intended to draw the heart closer to Jesus Christ through quiet reflection on the Gospels.
